image_description: A close-up, high-resolution portrait of a common iguana's head and upper neck. The subject is facing left, displaying detailed skin texture, a prominent dewlap, and the base of the dorsal crest. The background is heavily blurred (bokeh), isolating the subject.

Only the head and neck are visible; the main body torso is outside the frame or obscured by the tight crop.
